---
name: Legend idea
about: Propose a rare easter-egg ship or encounter
labels: content, legend
---

**What is it a nod to?** (a film, show, book, or *Elite*'s own lore)

**Name and one-line flavour text:**

**How does it look?** Describe your *own* take on the idea. Please don't attach copyrighted images or trace an on-screen design (see CONTRIBUTING.md → Legends and homages).

**Where and how rarely should it appear?** (e.g. "drifting near gas giants, about 1 in 300 jumps")

**What does it do when you find it?** (drifts, flees, cloaks, vanishes, something stranger…)

**Will you build it yourself?** Yes / No / With help
